nativeBaseline.reference: one native text input with one-time-code autocomplete and consumer-authored label/guidance

library: Preserve one native code input and native selection, editing, paste, autofill assistance, max length and form value. No forced focus movement, filtering or automatic verification.
Preserve the native text reset default and reconcile committed state without fabricating value-change intent.
consumer: Author a label, length/format guidance, optional pattern and errors; own verification, delivery, expiry, retry and authentication workflows.

notes: Native one-input contract replaces segmented multi-input focus/distribution; the public subpath remains.
Input mode is a hint, not a verification rule. Native one-time-code autofill/real authenticator interoperability and manual AT remain required evidence.
Audit mapping is provisional; not a conformance claim.
Native reset regressions cover leading-zero text, canceled reset, immediate native FormData and silent committed reconciliation; broader manual evidence remains open.
